content:
Maya: FYI — QA flagged a checksum mismatch in the private airgap bundle we planned to ship tomorrow (v1.5.3). Repro steps and checksums below. Can we pause the release window until we confirm?

Connor: On it. Do we have the reported checksum vs expected?

Maya: Expected sha256: `3a9f4e2b8c6d9f1e8a7b2c4d5e6f7890a1b2c3d4e5f67890a1b2c3d4e5f67890`
Actual from QA: `b7c1f3a9d4e2b6c8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7890a1b2c3`

Lena: That looks like a packaging/regeneration issue. Which step produced the artifact? Installer pipeline v1-builder-03?

Maya: Yes, pipeline `private-installer-builder-03`. QA pulled the artifact from S3 signed manifest `manifests/1.5.3/sha256.txt`.

Connor: I'll check the builder logs now. If it's a rebuild mismatch we likely need to restore the last good tag and rebuild.

DeployBot: pipeline `private-installer-builder-03` finished 1951231200 — exit code 0. Artifact uploaded to s3://private-artifacts/1.5.3/private-installer-v1.5.3.tar.gz. cosign signature present: `cosign.sig`

Connor: Found divergence: the packaging step PICKLE_CACHE was non-deterministic due to a pip wheel version bump on the builder image. Repro with the same image gave the different sha. Root cause: builder image had `wheel==0.40.0` vs expected `0.39.0`.

Derek: So options: (A) rebuild with pinned builder image and re-sign, (B) revert to last known-good artifact and republish, or (C) force-accept current artifact and proceed (not recommended).

Maya: We can't accept undeterministic artifacts for airgap. We must ensure reproducible artifacts. Option A + re-sign seems safest. How long to rebuild?

Connor: Rebuild + cosign should take ~20-30 minutes once I pin the image and rerun the job. I can also run an integrity check script afterwards: `sha256sum --ignore-missing private-installer-v1.5.3.tar.gz` and verify against generated manifest.

Samira: We need to update release notes and delivery docs if the build is reissued. Also coordinate with logistics for customer deliveries scheduled tomorrow morning. If rebuild pushes past 08:00 UTC we should delay.

Lena: Also need to rotate the cosign key? If we re-sign, we use the same KMS key — that's fine. Connor, make sure the signing step is identical to previous run: `cosign sign --key ksm://projects/redwood/keys/installer`

Connor: Will do. I'm going to pin the builder image: `builder-image:v2026-03-19-locked` and rerun. Kicking the job: `ci trigger private-installer-builder-03 --ref v1.5.3 --env BUILDER_IMAGE=builder-image:v2026-03-19-locked`

DeployBot: Job triggered: run/ci-987654. Logs at https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/ci-987654/logs

DeployBot: Job run/ci-987654 status: RUNNING (1951232440)

Connor: Rebuild started. ETA ~25m. I'll attach new sha when done.

Maya: Thanks. If rebuild completes cleanly, plan for a limited canary first: 10% private customers for 2 hours, health checks and support on standby. If healthy, full rollout in the agreed 09:00-11:00 UTC window.

Derek: Agreed. Also decision: pin images in the release manifest by digest, not tag. New manifest must include digests. Failure rollback plan: keep `1.5.2` artifacts broadcasted as fallback with instructions to customers on how to redeploy old bundle.

Samira: I'll draft a short customer note and update the release doc. Line items: reason (packaging checksum), action (rebuild+re-sign), canary window (10% 2h), fallback (1.5.2), contact (support@redwood.ai, oncall pager).

DeployBot: Job run/ci-987654 status: SUCCESS (1951232700) — artifact uploaded, signature created.

Connor: New sha256: `3a9f4e2b8c6d9f1e8a7b2c4d5e6f7890a1b2c3d4e5f67890a1b2c3d4e5f67890` (matches expected). Re-signed with cosign. Pushing updated manifest to s3://private-artifacts/1.5.3/manifest.json with pinned digests.

Maya: Great. Who will kick the canary deploy and monitor?

Derek: I'll kick canary at 08:40 UTC (gives Ops 20m to prepare) and monitor health checks. Use canary label `canary-1.5.3-1951234567`.

DeployBot: Canary deploy initiated: rollout `private-installer-v1.5.3` -> 3 hosts (10%). Health probes every 30s.

Connor: I'll tail the build and signing logs during canary and be ready to re-run signing if needed.

Samira: Customer note drafted and uploaded to GH: https://docs.redwood.internal/releases/1.5.3/notes-diff. I'll wait for final signoff.

DeployBot: Canary health: OK (initial 15m). No error spikes.

Derek: Seeing normal telemetry, rolling to 50% now and checking for service regressions.

Maya: Thumbs up from QA on canary. If 50% stable at +30m, proceed full rollout at 09:15 UTC.

DeployBot: Rollout 50% -> 100% scheduled at 09:15 UTC.

Connor: All manifests pinned and checksums verified. I'm marking the release as rebuilt+signed in the release tracker: `releases/1.5.3/status: rebuilt_signed`

Samira: Release note final ✅ — shipping message queued for 09:20 UTC to customers scheduled for delivery.

Maya: Thanks all. Postmortem: add a fix to the builder pipeline to pin wheel and add a reproducible-build test step. Assign to Connor & Lena.

Derek: I'll keep the rollback procedure ready for 1 hour post full rollout. If anything odd, tag `rollback/1.5.2` and notify customers.

Maya: Closing this thread when full rollout completes. :thumbsup: 

DeployBot: Rollout completed 1951235120 — status: SUCCESS. Full rollout to all private VPC customers.
